y-m-33-10.title: Quotient nezvasara kana uchipatsanura ne 2x−1: kutarisa mhinduro iyi
y-m-33-10.topic: Synthetic division nekupatsanura ne linear expression ine coefficient isiri 1
y-m-33-10.goal: Ongorora chii chinoramba chakafanana uye chii chinochinja kana uchitamisa mhedzisiro yekupatsanura ne x−1/2 kuenda kumhedzisiro yekupatsanura ne 2x−1, uye ugadzire ma expressions akati wandei anogutsa mamiriro ezvasara.
y-m-33-10.material: Mudzidzi aida kuwana quotient nezvasara kana P(x) = 2x³ − 3x² + x − 5 yapatsanurwa ne 2x − 1 akashandisa synthetic division uye akagadzirisa seizvi. (Maitiro ekuverenga: 2x³ i '2 x cubed', 2x−1 i '2x minus 1', 1/2 i 'one half')

y-m-33-10.prereq.1: Maitiro ekuwana quotient nezvasara kana uchipatsanura ne x−k uchishandisa synthetic division
y-m-33-10.s.s1.prompt: Mumhinduro yemudzidzi, sarudza mutsetse une mhedziso isingabvi pamitsetse yekare.
y-m-33-10.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora kuti divisor i chii mumutsetse 3 nemumutsetse 4, uye uzvienzanise.
y-m-33-10.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora division equation P(x) = (divisor) × (quotient) + remainder uchishandisa mhedzisiro yemutsetse 3, wobva wanyora zvakare divisor se 2x − 1.
y-m-33-10.s.s1.line.0: Kubva ku 2x − 1 = 0, x = 1/2, saka tinoita synthetic division ne 1/2.
y-m-33-10.s.s1.line.2: Saka quotient kana P(x) yapatsanurwa ne x − 1/2 i 2x² − 2x uye zvasara i −5.
y-m-33-10.s.s1.line.3: Ndiko kuti, quotient kana P(x) yapatsanurwa ne 2x − 1 i 2x² − 2x uye zvasara i −5.
y-m-33-10.s.s1.explain: I mutsetse 4. Kuverenga kwemitsetse 1 kusvika 3 kwakarurama. Quotient 2x²−2x yakawanikwa nesynthetic division i quotient kana uchipatsanura ne x−1/2. Unofanira kubvisa 2, sa P(x) = (x−1/2)(2x²−2x) − 5 = (2x−1)(x²−x) − 5, kuti uwane quotient kana uchipatsanura ne 2x−1. Zvasara −5 i imwechete muzviitiko zvose.
y-m-33-10.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza tsananguro dzese dzakarurama dzinoenzanisa kupatsanura P(x) imwechete ne x − 1/2 ne 2x − 1.
y-m-33-10.s.s2.hint.0: Mu P = (x−1/2)Q + R, nyora kuti nhamba ipi inofamba kupi kana ukanyora zvakare (x−1/2) se (2x−1).
y-m-33-10.s.s2.hint.1: Mushure mekutamisa, enzanisa zvinoiswa panzvimbo ye quotient nezvasara.
y-m-33-10.s.s2.r.a: Kutonga uku kunoona ma quotients seakafanana kunyange ma divisors akasiyana. Mu equation P = BQ + R, tarisa zvinoitika ku Q kana B yakasiyana.
y-m-33-10.s.s2.r.b: Sarudzo iyi yakafunga kuti sei zvasara zvisingachinji kunyange chimiro chedivisor chichichinja.
y-m-33-10.s.s2.o.c: Zvasara kana uchipatsanura ne 2x−1 zvinova hafu
y-m-33-10.s.s2.r.c: Kutonga uku kunoona remainder segoverwa pamwe chete nequotient. Hakuna kuongorora kwakasarudzwa remainder.
y-m-33-10.s.s2.o.d: Quotient kana ichigovaniswa ne2x−1 inova hafu
y-m-33-10.s.s2.r.d: Sarudzo iyi yakaverenga hukama pakati penhamba yakawanzwa mudivisor nequotient.
y-m-33-10.s.s2.explain: P = (x−1/2)·Q + R = (2x−1)·(Q/2) + R, saka quotient kana ichigovaniswa ne2x−1 i Q/2 uye remainder R haichinji. Pano Q = 2x²−2x, saka Q/2 = x²−x.
y-m-33-10.s.s3.prompt: Gadzira mutaurire wecubic P(x) = ax³ + bx² + cx + d (a, b, c, d maintegers kubva pa−9 kusvika pa9, uye a haisi 0) kuti remainder kana P(x) yagoverwa ne2x − 1 ive 3. Gadzira mitaurire 3 yakasiyana.
y-m-33-10.s.s3.hint.0: Fungidzira kuti unogona kunyora sei 'remainder i3' sekukosha kwe P pakukosha kwakati kwe x.
y-m-33-10.s.s3.hint.1: Tanga wagadzika dzimwe dza a, b, c, d, wobva wasarudza mavara asara kuti akodzere mamiriro.
y-m-33-10.s.s3.fail.c2: Kana coefficient a ye x³ i0, haisi mutaurire wecubic.
y-m-33-10.s.s3.fail.c3: Remainder haisi 3. Ongorora kana kukosha kwe P pa x inoita 2x−1=0 kuri 3.
y-m-33-10.s.s3.explain: Remainder kana yagoverwa ne2x−1 i P(1/2) = a/8 + b/4 + c/2 + d, uye iyi i3, saka kuwanza mativi ose maviri ne8 kunopa mamiriro a + 2b + 4c + 8d = 24. Pane maquadruples akawanda emaintegers anoita mamiriro aya. Semuenzaniso, kune (4, 2, 4, 0), P(1/2) = 1/2 + 1/2 + 2 + 0 = 3.

y-m-33-04.title: Tinofanira kutarisa chii kuti titaure kuti hapana chinhu chemutsetse?
y-m-33-04.topic: Kusarudza zvinhu zvemutsetse zvechirevo che cubic (tichishandisa factor theorem)
y-m-33-04.goal: Enzanisa nokuongorora mhedzisiro yokuparadzanisa inowanikwa nenzira dzakasiyana, tsvaga gwatidzo mukupokana kwakatarisa dzimwe nhamba dzakasarudzwa chete, uye utaure kuti kutarisa kupi kunodikanwa kumhedziso yokuti 'hapana chinhu' nemhando apo mhedziso iyi inoshanda.
y-m-33-04.material: Tinotarisa kana chirevo che cubic chine ma coefficients ari nhamba dzizere chingaparadzanwa kuva chakawanikwa chezvirevo zvemutsetse zvine ma coefficients ari nhamba dzizere. Mina akagadzirisa P(x) = x³ − 3x² − 4x + 12 nokuunganidza mazwi mapeya kutsvaga zvinhu zvakafanana, akawana (x − 3)(x² − 4). Doyun akashandisa nzira pachirevo chimwe chete: isa vaparadzanisi vechokwadi chokungogara 12, ±1, ±2, ±3, ±4, ±6, ±12, tsvaga x apo kukosha kwa P ndi 0, uye uwane chinhu chemutsetse. Shure kwaizvozvo, tinoongorora T(x) = x³ + 2x² + 3x + 4 nenzira yaDoyun. (Nzira yokuverenga: x³ ndi 'x kubhiki', ± ndi 'pamwe kana kubvisa')

y-m-33-06.title: Expression imwe chete, 'quotients ne remainders' dzakasiyana?
y-m-33-06.topic: Identity A=BQ+R ye polynomial division uye mamiriro e degree ye remainder
y-m-33-06.goal: Tsimbisa nekugadzira iwe pachako kuti pangava ne ma equations akawanda ane chimiro A = BQ + R, uye utsanangure kuti mamiriro e degree ye remainder anodiwa kuti quotient ne remainder ye division zvitarwe seimwe.
y-m-33-06.material: A(x) = x³ + 2x + 1 ne B(x) = x² + 1. Jiho akanyora A(x) = B(x)·x + (x + 1), uye Soeun akanyora A(x) = B(x)·(x + 1) + (−x² + x). Vose vanoti vakawana 'quotient ne remainder kana A yaparadzaniswa ne B'. (Nzira yekuverenga: A(x) ndi 'A ye x', B(x)·x ndi 'B ye x kuwedzerwa ne x')

y-m-33-06.thinking.2: Kutsanangura mamiriro anodiwa kuti pave nemhinduro imwe chete

y-m-33-06.prereq.3: Chimiro chemhedzisiro yekuparadzanisa polynomial ne polynomial, A = BQ + R

y-m-33-06.s.s1.r.a: Izvi zvakagamuchira seiyo mhedzisiro ye division nekungotarisa kana equation ichishanda. Hazvina kuongorora chimiro che remainder.
y-m-33-06.s.s1.o.b: Equation yaSoeun yakashata nekuti kana yawedzerwa inosiyana ne A
y-m-33-06.s.s1.r.b: Pamwe wakatonga nekuti chimiro chinoratidzika chakasiyana, usina kuenzanisa mhedzisiro yekuwedzera chaizvo. Kana yawedzerwa, yakaenzana ne A.

y-m-33-06.s.s1.explain: B·x + (x+1) = x³+x+x+1 = x³+2x+1, uye B·(x+1) + (−x²+x) = x³+x²+x+1−x²+x = x³+2x+1. Vose vari identities. Asi kuti titore seiquotient ne remainder, unofanirawo kuongorora kana degree ye remainder iri pasi pe degree ye B (2).
y-m-33-06.s.s2.prompt: Isa Q(x) = x + q (q ndi integer kubva ku−3 kusvika ku3), uye utsvage integer coefficients u, v, w dze R(x) = ux² + vx + w kuti A(x) = B(x)·Q(x) + R(x) ive identity. Gadzira mienzaniso 3 ine q dzakasiyana.

y-m-33-09.material: Ruzivo rwaviri rwakapiwa pa real numbers a ne b: a + b = 4 ne a² + b² = 6. Minjae anoda kuwana mutengo we a³ + b³ kubva paruzivo urwu. (Maitiro ekuverenga: a² + b² i 'a squared plus b squared')

y-m-33-09.s.s1.r.b: Kuverenga uku kunobvisa 3ab chete pasina kuwanza ne (a+b) mu 3ab(a+b).
y-m-33-09.s.s1.r.c: Iyi i mhedzisiro yekutanga kuwana ab wobva waverenga huwandu hwema cubes uchishandisa huwandu neproduct.
y-m-33-09.s.s1.r.d: Iyi i mhedzisiro yakaverengwa nekuisa mutengo we a²+b² panzvimbo ye ab. Mabasa ehuwandu neproduct akashandurana.
